# ROOT is the country that acts, FROM the one it acts on. The AI never sends these (EU4).

# Gommo Branches: a branch of the Gommo in the capital of an ally or a subject, a commission on our bench.
DA_GN_open_branch = {
	category = influence
	require_acceptance = no
	is_visible = {
		has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_Branches
		FROM = { OR = { alliance_with = ROOT is_subject_of = ROOT } }
	}
	is_allowed = {
		DA_GN_branch_target_ok = yes
		DA_GN_can_branch = yes
	}
	on_accept = {
		DA_GN_start_branch = yes
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		always = no
	}
}

# The International Gommo: a licence for a patent that is switched on; DA_GN_event.10 asks which.
DA_GN_license_patent = {
	category = influence
	require_acceptance = no
	is_visible = {
		has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.GN_International
		FROM = { OR = { alliance_with = ROOT is_subject_of = ROOT } }
	}
	is_allowed = {
		DA_GN_lic_target_ok = yes
		DA_GN_can_license = yes
	}
	on_accept = {
		FROM = { save_event_target_as = DA_GN_licensee }
		country_event = { id = DA_GN_event.10 }
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		always = no
	}
}
